name: Nordreth Frame 171 EGEO
description: Key Features Impact-Damped Construction: Designed with advanced impact-damping technology to minimize vibrations, providing a stable and quiet environment ideal for music, dance, or theater rehearsals. Spacious Floor Area: Offers 116 square metres of open, flexible floor space, accommodating a variety of group activities and creative setups. Low Noise Floor (23 dBA): Maintains an exceptionally quiet ambient noise level, supporting clear audio playback, recording, and focused practice sessions. High Occupancy Capacity: Comfortably supports up to 19 people, making it suitable for medium-sized ensembles, workshops, or group rehearsals. Double-Shell Air Gap Isolation: Utilizes a double-shell air gap isolation method to effectively block external noise and prevent sound leakage, ensuring privacy and minimal disturbance. Flexible Session Length: Standard session duration is 3 hours, providing ample time for extended rehearsals or creative work. Custom Session Fee: Session fee is determined after acceptance, allowing for tailored pricing based on specific requirements. Main Benefits Superior Sound Control: The combination of impact-damping and double-shell air gap isolation ensures a distraction-free, acoustically optimized rehearsal space. Versatility: The large, open floor plan accommodates diverse activities, from band practices and dance classes to theater run-throughs and workshops. Enhanced Privacy and Comfort: Low noise levels and robust sound isolation offer a comfortable, private setting for creative collaboration or focused practice. Adaptable Scheduling and Pricing: Flexible session lengths and customizable fees cater to varying user needs and budgets. Typical Use Cases or Outcomes Music and Band Rehearsals: Ideal for groups seeking a quiet, acoustically treated space for practice, recording, or jam sessions. Dance and Movement Classes: Spacious, impact-damped flooring supports dance rehearsals, fitness classes, and choreography sessions. Theater and Performance Workshops: Provides a controlled environment for script readings, acting workshops, or full-cast rehearsals. Audio and Video Recording: Low ambient noise and sound isolation make it suitable for audio recording, video shoots, or content creation. Collaborative Meetings: Supports creative meetings, brainstorming sessions, and group training events with ample space and minimal distractions. Common User Questions Addressed Is the space quiet and private? Yes, the 23 dBA noise floor and double-shell air gap isolation ensure a peaceful, private environment. How many people can use the space? The loft accommodates up to 19 occupants comfortably. Is the session length flexible? Standard sessions last 3 hours, with session fees set after acceptance to match your needs. Is the loft suitable for recording or sensitive audio work? Absolutely—its low noise floor and advanced sound isolation make it ideal for audio-sensitive activities.
description_html:
Key Features

  • Impact-Damped Construction: Designed with advanced impact-damping technology to minimize vibrations, providing a stable and quiet environment ideal for music, dance, or theater rehearsals.
  • Spacious Floor Area: Offers 116 square metres of open, flexible floor space, accommodating a variety of group activities and creative setups.
  • Low Noise Floor (23 dBA): Maintains an exceptionally quiet ambient noise level, supporting clear audio playback, recording, and focused practice sessions.
  • High Occupancy Capacity: Comfortably supports up to 19 people, making it suitable for medium-sized ensembles, workshops, or group rehearsals.
  • Double-Shell Air Gap Isolation: Utilizes a double-shell air gap isolation method to effectively block external noise and prevent sound leakage, ensuring privacy and minimal disturbance.
  • Flexible Session Length: Standard session duration is 3 hours, providing ample time for extended rehearsals or creative work.
  • Custom Session Fee: Session fee is determined after acceptance, allowing for tailored pricing based on specific requirements.

Main Benefits

  • Superior Sound Control: The combination of impact-damping and double-shell air gap isolation ensures a distraction-free, acoustically optimized rehearsal space.
  • Versatility: The large, open floor plan accommodates diverse activities, from band practices and dance classes to theater run-throughs and workshops.
  • Enhanced Privacy and Comfort: Low noise levels and robust sound isolation offer a comfortable, private setting for creative collaboration or focused practice.
  • Adaptable Scheduling and Pricing: Flexible session lengths and customizable fees cater to varying user needs and budgets.

Typical Use Cases or Outcomes

  • Music and Band Rehearsals: Ideal for groups seeking a quiet, acoustically treated space for practice, recording, or jam sessions.
  • Dance and Movement Classes: Spacious, impact-damped flooring supports dance rehearsals, fitness classes, and choreography sessions.
  • Theater and Performance Workshops: Provides a controlled environment for script readings, acting workshops, or full-cast rehearsals.
  • Audio and Video Recording: Low ambient noise and sound isolation make it suitable for audio recording, video shoots, or content creation.
  • Collaborative Meetings: Supports creative meetings, brainstorming sessions, and group training events with ample space and minimal distractions.

Common User Questions Addressed

  • Is the space quiet and private? Yes, the 23 dBA noise floor and double-shell air gap isolation ensure a peaceful, private environment.
  • How many people can use the space? The loft accommodates up to 19 occupants comfortably.
  • Is the session length flexible? Standard sessions last 3 hours, with session fees set after acceptance to match your needs.
  • Is the loft suitable for recording or sensitive audio work? Absolutely—its low noise floor and advanced sound isolation make it ideal for audio-sensitive activities.
